name: 3SBio Inc.
summary: 3SBio Inc., an investment holding company, engages in the development, production, marketing, and sale of biopharmaceutical products in the People's Republic of China, the United States, and internationally. The company offers TPIAO bio-pharmaceutical drug for the treatment of chemotherapy-induced thrombocytopenia, immune thrombocytopenia, pediatric ITP, and chronic liver disease-related thrombocytopenia.
